title: Otto (hermes gateway on the cluster) crash-looped through two copy-flag fixes
detected_by: oke-check run 33281380053 (chaos drill red), then the founder asking 'is Otto back?' at 2026-08-30T00:4xZ

timeline.what: Tailscale operator HelmRelease UpgradeFailed; hermes-agent sidecar depends on it
gateway refuses boot: bin/hermes 0644 on the PVC, test -x fails (plain cp keeps an existing file's mode)
new image main-38-eb48806d boots and crash-loops: cp: preserving permissions for '/data/.': Operation not permitted (56 restarts in 39 min)
hermes-v2#54 opened: copy without modes, chmod bin/ after; K8sGPT produced no finding (analyzer blocked by kyverno webhook, idp#873)

root_cause: cp -R --preserve=mode on "$BUILD"/. onto the volume root tries to chmod /data itself, which the pod does not own. The first fix (plain cp) had the opposite fault: it leaves an existing file's mode alone.
founder_words: is Otto back? / incident reports are learning opportunity and training data for estate / the estate itself can learn
